lines.text: The Corinthians were once pagans who were led astray to mute idols.
There are different gifts, but the same Spirit, and different ministries, but the same Lord.
Gifts such as wisdom, knowledge, faith and healing come from the Spirit, who gives them as He determines.
The body is one unit with many parts, and Jews or Samaritans, slave or free, were all baptized into it.
